title: microphacos parviflorus
intro: Microphacos parviflorus, commonly known as Microphacos, is a plant species that belongs to the family Fabaceae. It is used for its medicinal properties, with reported health benefits including the treatment of fever, diarrhea, and inflammation. The plant's therapeutic actions are attributed to its ability to exhibit antimicrobial, anti-inflammatory, and antioxidant properties. The bioactive constituents of Microphacos include flavonoids, alkaloids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal effects.
